title: Repeat Product Loyalty
scenario: Find 'customer_id' who bought the exact same set of products at least twice (requires normalization/string aggregation).
hint: Use GROUP_CONCAT to create a product signature for each transaction event if timestamps existed; here, check count vs distinct.
correctQuery: SELECT customer_id FROM customer GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > COUNT(DISTINCT product_key);
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE customer (customer_id INT, product_key INT); INSERT INTO customer VALUES (1, 5), (1, 5);
